regime_context: In China A-shares, the detector shows narrow technology leadership with Semiconductors and AI Compute atop the momentum ranks, but historical backtests indicate rank-IC ~0 and the absolute trend gate did not reduce drawdown here (mean-reverting tape). Rotation is narrow and non-directional. Given the weak empirical edge, any thematic lean is experimental and conviction should be subdued.
emerging_watch: AI Compute & Optics as a potential confirmed handoff — if its momentum score overtakes Semiconductors by a margin >0.1 for 5 consecutive days and it becomes the rotation leader, the tech leadership may shift. Kill-criterion: Semiconductors reasserts a >0.2 score lead or AI Compute’s absolute trend eligibility breaks.

theses.subject: Semiconductors
theses.thesis: Semiconductors hold the top momentum rank, are eligible on the absolute trend gate (hurst=trend, durability 0.58), and are not crowded. While momentum carries no forward return edge historically, the theme’s trend health and leadership position support a modest tilt for now, strictly as a trend-following focus. The lean is fragile given the weak signal quality in Chinese equities and the narrow rotation margin.
theses.dissent: Mean-reverting A-share sector dynamics have historically whipsawed trend gates, so the absolute uptrend could break abruptly. Narrow rotation and a 30-day challenger (AI Compute) just 0.14 points behind raise the risk of leadership reversal without warning.

falsifier.text: Semiconductors lose absolute trend eligibility (durability drops below 0.4 or hurst shifts to 'mean-revert') OR AI Compute overtakes with a sustained momentum-score lead for 5 consecutive days.
